item.stem:
The diagram shows Falguni's square sheet of side $12\,\mathrm{cm}$ with centre marked $O$. She wants a circular arc of radius $3\,\mathrm{cm}$ with centre $O$, drawn with a compass.

Which claim correctly states where the compass point must be placed and what radius is needed?

options.A: Place the compass point at $O$ and open the compass to radius $3\,\mathrm{cm}$.
options.B: Place the compass point at a corner of the square and open it to $12\,\mathrm{cm}$.
options.C: Opening the compass to $3\,\mathrm{cm}$ is what creates the centre $O$.
options.D: Freehand sketch quality settles the arc, so the compass point may be anywhere.
